There is no checkout under data/checkouts (hifi-gan, HiFi-GAN, official-hifi-gan), no repository revision, no LICENSE/notice bundle and no source digest. No exact weight identity exists. No universal or fine-tuned HiFi-GAN generator checkpoint, ONNX graph, byte count, SHA-256, release tag or linked asset-ledger row is recorded. Fixed probes are absent: data/checkouts/hifi-gan, data/checkouts/HiFi-GAN, data/checkouts/official-hifi-gan, data/models/hifi-gan, the generator_v1/v2/v3 directories, data/models/hifigan/g_hifigan.pt, data/models/hifigan/g_hifigan.onnx and cpp-library/.deps/hifigan.onnx. Two derived modules are visible inside unrelated projects (CosyVoice Apache-2.0, Seed-VC GPL-3.0) but neither is the official release and neither has a weight file.

No runtime is present or pinned. There is no recorded Python, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime or other host version, wheel digest, target platform, lock file or evaluator environment; the current interpreter has no torch, onnxruntime, numpy or scipy. No exact-runtime reference run, parity vector or inference was produced.

Rights and consent are unresolved. The rights register has no hifi-gan or hifigan entry, so acquisition, evaluation, redistribution, customer deployment and public playback are all unknown. No artifact-specific written terms exist. For a voice task, consent for source and target speaker references, permitted reference availability and permitted output use are independent gates and none is recorded; evaluation-only status is not established.

No candidate geometry is known. No universal HiFi-GAN sample rate, hop, mel configuration, upsample layout, receptive field, chunk lookahead or streaming state is recorded, so this package deliberately fabricates none and exposes no v0 frame adapter. The 160-sample hop in the surrogate is a fixture parameter shared with installed v0, not candidate geometry.

The comparison requested by the task is not reproducible from local evidence. The pinned research record classifies the candidate out of scope because a vocoder reconstructs waveform from fixed acoustic features and does not independently transform input voice or accent. No fixed upstream feature set, acoustic model or vocoder-swap control exists, so the research-control comparison cannot be retained or reproduced.

No candidate evidence exists. There is no output, exact-reference parity, rights-cleared paired voice cohort with permitted source/target references, independent semantic or speaker-identity scorer, naturalness assessment, listening result or target-runtime timing. The synthetic surrogate is not HiFi-GAN and cannot qualify the candidate. All eight release gates remain blocked and no result may qualify the candidate.
